400,000 square foot site takes Arvato’s total Louisville footprint beyond four million square feet.

By DC Velocity Staff Oct 05, 2026

DC Velocity Staff See Full Bio 

The supply chain management and e-commerce third party logistics provider (3PL) Arvato has opened its seventh logistics facility in Louisville, Kentucky, saying the move further expands its presence in one of the United States’ most important logistics hubs.

The new, wholly-owned site adds approximately 400,000 square feet of capacity, taking Arvato’s total Louisville footprint beyond four million square feet. Expected to create approximately 150 new jobs, the facility further strengthens the company’s ability to support growing fulfillment and distribution requirements for clients across North America, Arvato said.

# Wagner Logistics to Add Nearly 80 Jobs with New High-Volume Logistics Operation in Liberty

 Wagner Logistics 

Oct 14, 2026, 08:54 ET

NORTH KANSAS CITY, Mo., Oct. 14, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Wagner Logistics, a nationwide provider of third-party logistics, today announced it has signed a multi-year agreement with a Kansas City-area manufacturer to launch a new manufacturing support and warehouse operations program in Liberty, Mo.

The new operation includes two leased warehouse facilities in the Liberty area totaling more than 830,000 square feet. Wagner expects to add 79 new local jobs over the next two years, starting immediately. The company will also make a multi-million-dollar investment in equipment, infrastructure and automated trailer loading and unloading technology to support the operation.

# Prozo Opens 1.1 Lakh Sq Ft Fulfilment Centre in Bhiwandi

 01 Oct 2026 2 Min Read CW Team 

Prozo has launched a new 1.1 lakh sq ft fulfilment centre in Bhiwandi, strengthening its warehousing and logistics footprint in Maharashtra.

The facility is Prozo’s largest in the Bhiwandi region and expands its Western India network to 10 fulfilment centres with a combined area of 7.1 lakh sq ft.

Located within Bhiwandi’s established warehousing and logistics cluster, the centre is positioned along the Mumbai-Nashik corridor. It provides access to Mumbai and other markets across western and central India.

The facility is also located near Jawaharlal Nehru Port, the Eastern Express Highway and the Samruddhi Expressway, supporting regional and national movement of goods.

The expansion comes amid strong warehousing demand in the Mumbai region. According to Vestian, Mumbai recorded 5.04 million sq ft of warehousing absorption in Q2 2026, with the Bhiwandi corridor accounting for nearly 69 per cent of the city’s total absorption.

# Inside Our New 210,000 Sq. Ft. Deltaport Warehouse

 by Bill Heaney | Logistics 

Every hour a container sits is an hour of cost. Demurrage clocks, per diem charges, congested truck gates, and long drayage runs to inland warehouses all quietly erode margin on freight that has already crossed an ocean. For importers moving volume through the Pacific Gateway, the distance between the terminal gate and the first set of dock doors matters more than almost any other variable in the inbound supply chain.

That is exactly the gap our newest facility closes. As of August 1, 2026, 18 Wheels Warehousing and Trucking has taken possession of a 210,000 square foot distribution facility at 3995 27B Avenue in Delta (Tsawwassen), positioned directly adjacent to Deltaport, Canada's primary container terminal. It is one of the shortest drayage moves available to shippers arriving through Metro Vancouver, and it is now part of our national network.

Davidson Logistics celebrated the grand opening of its new warehouse in Bridgeton on Thursday.

By First Alert 4 Staff

Published: Oct. 8, 2026 at 6:44 PM CDT

BRIDGETON, Mo. (First Alert 4) - Davidson Logistics celebrated the grand opening of its new warehouse in Bridgeton on Thursday.

The opening marks the latest step in the company’s expansion, which began more than 40 years ago. Davidson provides delivery and inventory services to major companies, including General Electric and Boeing.

The new warehouse is part of the company’s broader expansion plans. Its president says future contracts with Boeing could allow Davidson to hire as many as 200 workers.
